newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers drift down, rest of Europe confused.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers drift down, rest of Europe confused.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices drifted down from the high offered level on Tuesday, while bunkers at many other ports were mixed, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at around $90 fob by the close. Offers dropped from $95 to $91/$92 fob ARA as the barge market lost faith in the sharp rise seen on Tuesday.
"People saw some demand in the bunker market and the prices just rocketed. It was all overdone," one supplier said.
Total ARA volume was little more than 10,000 tonnes, significantly down from the large volumes seen traded on Tuesday.

Hamburg bunkers were little changed from Tuesday, but quotes varied substantially. Many suppliers offered at around $95 fob, only to discover one major selling a large order to a shipping firm at $90. Suppliers said the low price was the result of short-term oversupply at the single refinery.
Mediterranean prices mostly weakened by around $1 a tonne. Fujairah prices did likewise after the Singapore market failed to hold.
Saudi Aramco cut bunker prices in the Gulf and Red Sea, both to $102. Gas oil bunkers went down sharply.
